# Reading fonts

Free, openly licensed fonts for the text reader's font picker (`js/fonts.js`). Each folder holds the font files, its `LICENSE` and a `VERSION` note saying where the files came from.

| Folder | Font | Resembles | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arimo` | Arimo (Steve Matteson, Google) | Arial, Helvetica (same letter widths as Arial) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `dejavu-sans` | DejaVu Sans (from Bitstream Vera) | Verdana | Bitstream Vera licence; DejaVu changes public domain |
| `comic-neue` | Comic Neue (Craig Rozynski) | Comic Sans | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `lexend` | Lexend (Bonnie Shaver-Troup, Thomas Jockin) | — | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `atkinson-hyperlegible` | Atkinson Hyperlegible (Braille Institute) | — | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `opendyslexic` | OpenDyslexic (Abbie Gonzalez) | Dyslexie | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Arial, Helvetica, Verdana, Comic Sans and Dyslexie themselves are commercial fonts and are not included. Folio names the free fonts by their own names and only mentions the well-known font each one resembles.
